51: /-! ### Measurability
52: 
53: Before we define the product measure, we can talk about the measurability of operations on binary
54: functions. We show that if `f` is a binary measurable function, then the function that integrates
55: along one of the variables (using either the Lebesgue or Bochner integral) is measurable.
56: -/

139: /-- The Bochner integral is a.e.-measurable.
140:   This shows that the integrand of (the right-hand-side of) Fubini's theorem is a.e.-measurable. -/
141: theorem MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right' [SFinite ν] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
142:     ⦃f : α × β → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.prod ν)) :
143:     AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν) μ :=
144:   ⟨fun x => ∫ y, hf.mk f (x, y) ∂ν, hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk.integral_prod_right', by
145:     filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_prod hf.ae_eq_mk] with _ hx using integral_congr_ae hx⟩

228: /-- A binary function is integrable if the function `y ↦ f (x, y)` is integrable for almost every
229:   `x` and the function `x ↦ ∫ ‖f (x, y)‖ dy` is integrable. -/
230: theorem integrable_prod_iff ⦃f : α × β → E⦄ (h1f : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.prod ν)) :
231:     Integrable f (μ.prod ν) ↔
232:       (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Integrable (fun y => f (x, y)) ν) ∧ Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂ν) μ := by
233:   simp [Integrable, h1f, hasFiniteIntegral_prod_iff', h1f.norm.integral_prod_right',
234:     h1f.prodMk_left]
235: 
236: /-- A binary function is integrable if the function `x ↦ f (x, y)` is integrable for almost every
237:   `y` and the function `y ↦ ∫ ‖f (x, y)‖ dx` is integrable. -/
238: theorem integrable_prod_iff' [SFinite μ] ⦃f : α × β → E⦄
239:     (h1f : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.prod ν)) :
240:     Integrable f (μ.prod ν) ↔
241:       (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, Integrable (fun x => f (x, y)) μ) ∧ Integrable (fun y => ∫ x, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂μ) ν := by
242:   convert! integrable_prod_iff h1f.prod_swap using 1

334: theorem Integrable.integral_prod_left ⦃f : α × β → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f (μ.prod ν)) :
335:     Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν) μ := by
336:   apply Integrable.mono hf.integral_norm_prod_left hf.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
337:   filter_upwards with x
338:   grw [norm_integral_le_integral_norm]
339:   exact le_abs_self _

341: theorem Integrable.integral_prod_right [SFinite μ] ⦃f : α × β → E⦄
342:     (hf : Integrable f (μ.prod ν)) : Integrable (fun y => ∫ x, f (x, y) ∂μ) ν :=
343:   hf.swap.integral_prod_left

465:   This version has the integrals on the right-hand side in the other order. -/
466: theorem integral_prod_symm (f : α × β → E) (hf : Integrable f (μ.prod ν)) :
467:     ∫ z, f z ∂μ.prod ν = ∫ y, ∫ x, f (x, y) ∂μ ∂ν := by
468:   rw [← integral_prod_swap f]; exact integral_prod _ hf.swap

470: /-- Reversed version of **Fubini's Theorem**. -/
471: theorem integral_integral {f : α → β → E} (hf : Integrable (uncurry f) (μ.prod ν)) :
472:     ∫ x, ∫ y, f x y ∂ν ∂μ = ∫ z, f z.1 z.2 ∂μ.prod ν :=
473:   (integral_prod _ hf).symm
474: 
475: /-- Reversed version of **Fubini's Theorem** (symmetric version). -/
476: theorem integral_integral_symm {f : α → β → E} (hf : Integrable (uncurry f) (μ.prod ν)) :
477:     ∫ x, ∫ y, f x y ∂ν ∂μ = ∫ z, f z.2 z.1 ∂ν.prod μ :=
478:   (integral_prod_symm _ hf.swap).symm
479: 
480: /-- Change the order of Bochner integration. -/
481: theorem integral_integral_swap ⦃f : α → β → E⦄ (hf : Integrable (uncurry f) (μ.prod ν)) :
482:     ∫ x, ∫ y, f x y ∂ν ∂μ = ∫ y, ∫ x, f x y ∂μ ∂ν :=
483:   (integral_integral hf).trans (integral_prod_symm _ hf)
484: 
485: /-- Change the order of integration, when one of the integrals is an interval integral. -/
486: lemma intervalIntegral_integral_swap {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → α → E}
487:     (h_int : Integrable (uncurry f) ((volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)).prod μ)) :
488:     ∫ x in a..b, ∫ y, f x y ∂μ = ∫ y, (∫ x in a..b, f x y) ∂μ := by
489:   rcases le_total a b with (hab | hab)
490:   · simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]

207: theorem rpow_add (hx : 0 < x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z := by
208:   simp only [rpow_def_of_pos hx, mul_add, exp_add]

258: /-- See also `rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow` for a version with `x⁻¹ ^ y` in the RHS. -/
259: theorem rpow_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : x ^ (-y) = (x ^ y)⁻¹ := by
260:   simp only [rpow_def_of_nonneg hx]; split_ifs <;> simp_all [exp_neg]

262: theorem rpow_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y - z) = x ^ y / x ^ z := by
263:   simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, rpow_add hx, rpow_neg (le_of_lt hx), div_eq_mul_inv]

476: theorem mul_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z := by
477:   rw [rpow_def_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
478:   split_ifs with nz
479:   on_goal 3 =>
480:     rw [← Ne, mul_ne_zero_iff] at nz
481:     rw [log_mul nz.1 nz.2, add_mul, exp_add, rpow_def_of_pos (hx.lt_of_ne' nz.1),
482:       rpow_def_of_pos (hy.lt_of_ne' nz.2)]
483:   all_goals simp_all

485: theorem inv_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : x⁻¹ ^ y = (x ^ y)⁻¹ := by
486:   rw [← rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow, rpow_neg hx]

488: theorem div_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (z : ℝ) : (x / y) ^ z = x ^ z / y ^ z := by
489:   simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_rpow hx (inv_nonneg.2 hy), inv_rpow hy]

998: theorem rpow_div_two_eq_sqrt {x : ℝ} (r : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ^ (r / 2) = √x ^ r := by
999:   rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, ← rpow_mul hx]
1000:   congr
